patthana20.5:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na sārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na sārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sārammaṇo ca anārammaṇo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.5:2.1: na anārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.5:3.1: na sārammaṇañca. na anārammaṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.5:5.1: na cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca citto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no citto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca citto ca no citto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.5:6.1: na no cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no citto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana20.5:7.1: na cittañca na no cittañca dhammaṃ paṭicca no citto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana20.5:9.1: na cetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca acetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cetasiko ca acetasiko ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana20.5:11.1: na cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasampayutto ca cittavippayutto ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana20.5:12.1: na cittavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cittavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasampayutto ca-. dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana20.5:15.1: na cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittasaṃsaṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭho ca no cittavisaṃsaṭṭho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana20.5:17.1: na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno ca no cittasamuṭṭhāno ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana20.5:19.1: na cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasahabhū ca no cittasahabhū ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana20.5:21.1: na cittānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittānuparivatti dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cittānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittānuparivatti dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na cittānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittānuparivatti ca no cittānuparivatti ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana20.5:23.1: na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana20.5:25.1: na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana20.5:27.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivatti dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana20.5:29.1: na ajjhattikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.5:30.1: na bāhiraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.5:33.1: na upādā dhammaṃ paṭicca upādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana20.5:35.1: na upādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
